span.p:
1. HAProxy sends the client IP
to the agent

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. The SPOA agent looks up the IP
in the local reputation database

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. The SPOA agent compares the IP categories
with the blocked categories (DROP_BY_CATEGORY)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. The SPOA agent answers
ip_bad = true or false

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. HAProxy reads ip_bad
and applies its rules
